test_title: PYST 24: SSC JE ME - Reassoning (Held on: 16 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown (Figures 1-3). Find the number on the face opposite to the face having ‘2’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/876f0ca658ba3ca90af1adebce14f137c4bda42ebc6a037fb38885bd66f184b7.png]
solution:
When we compare figure 1 and figure 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3dc1ddb94a5fc18d785b1a2d925697ae15b221d73b640bd5ddf69432bcd6cc8.png] We can see that 3 is opposite to 4.

When we compare figure 1 and figure 3:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bd3face485e1bf4b8983128c36bdd492d40421a79de165da9a024954a5ee48f.png] We can see that 5 is opposite to 1.

Now we only have two faces left i.e., 2 and 6 which means 2 and 6 are opposite to each other.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
